description: The NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center (FLC) Yokosuka Site Sasebo intends to issue a competitive solicitation for USS RUSHMORE (LSD-47)  38E9313601_00_A01 NONSKID DECK COVERING AND DECK PLATE AT 06 LEVEL WEATHER DECK; REPLACE to Master Ship Repair Agreement (MSRA) and capable Agreement for Boat Repair (ABR) holders in Japan only.
